estimates.assumptions: 250g dark/plain baking chocolate (approx 70% cocoa); values based on typical nutritional data for solid dark chocolate.
175g unsalted butter (full quantity incorporated into batter).
2 tbsp (30ml) semi-skimmed milk; modest estimate for small liquid addition.
5 large whole eggs (~50g edible portion each); full quantity used raw in batter.
175g granulated white sugar (full quantity creamed into batter).
125g plain/all-purpose wheat flour (full quantity folded into batter).
